issues.issue: Is the 2024 grievance filed by the Applicant timely under the 25-day limit in the Collective Agreement?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant argues ongoing violations support timeliness and did not challenge 25-day limit.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent submits grievance is out of time based on 2013 and 2021 events.
issues.result_text: Decision that grievance was filed out of time is reasonable and not unreasonable.

issues.issue: Is the decision to refuse salary protection at FB-07 pay rate on the merits reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant argues different decisions would have been made if 2012 Committee recommendation accepted and disagrees with decision.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent submits retroactive pay consistent with Wilkinson and FB-07 MRP position no longer exists.
issues.result_text: Decision is coherent, rational, transparent, and justified; no central errors identified by Applicant.
